response.justification: The candidate is a versatile, experienced senior engineer with strong testing culture, mentoring inclination, and some high-throughput systems experience (low-latency D services at Dunnhumby/Sociomantic). However, he falls well short of the core minimum qualification of 8 years of C++ — his C++ exposure is limited to roughly six months at National Instruments and a thesis project. His career centers on web/full-stack work (TypeScript, Node.js, D) rather than large-scale cloud compute infrastructure, and he has no formal technical-leadership role leading platform strategy or managing cross-team deliverables at scale.
strengths: Low-latency, high-throughput systems experience (millions of HTTP requests/sec at Dunnhumby/Sociomantic)
Strong engineering practices: TDD, CI/CD, trunk-based development, and open-source tooling authorship
Demonstrated mentoring and knowledge-sharing through workshops, courses, and conference talks
concerns: Far below the required 8 years of C++ experience (~6 months professional C++)
No formal technical-leadership experience leading platform strategy or cloud/DevOps teams
Career focused on web/full-stack product work rather than cloud compute, storage, or hardware-scale infrastructure

key_factors.factor: Limited cloud infrastructure and technical leadership background
